title: *FLAILS AROUND* SUMMER SPECIAL! JOIN NITRO, GET AN EXTRA MONTH OF NITRO ON US!
summary: NITRO, NITRO, NITRO! From now until July 15th, 2025, if qualifying users start a new monthly Nitro membership, they’ll get a SECOND month of Discord Nitro to top ‘em off!
body:
*lazily swings around in the wind* WACKY INFLATABLE FLAILING WUMPUS HEeEeeERE, SPEAKING TO YOU FROM THE NITROOO MOTOR GARAAAAGE! We got a hUUUGE summer special for anyone out there who’s not currently a Nitro member! 

“What IS Discord Nitro,” you’re asking? Well, listen in, ‘cause I’m about to blow your engines with this fact drop: Nitro gets you MORE emoji and stickers, MORE ways to customize your profile, MORE ways to show off your sick gameplay with higher-quality streaming and bigger file-sharing. It’s Discord but more, sooooooo much more!!!!

Check out NITROOO on desktop

Convinced? We know. Now come drive along SUBSCRIBER SPEEDWAY. We’ve got a S-S-S-SPECIAL SUMMER DEEEAAALL (DEAL!!!!) that you’re gonna wanna speed u- I mean, read up on!

‍From now until July 15th, 2025, eligible users who start a monthly Nitro membership will get a SECOND month of Discord Nitro ON US******! That’s 60 days of Discord at its BEST for the price of 30 days!‍

****** Not actually ON us though. Tha’d hurt. Nitro is heavy. Have you SEEN that jetpack Wumpus uses?

Eyes WIDE in amazement? Jaw on the floor? Engine revved up and ready to drive towards this WILD deal? LISTEN UP, and we’ll tell ya how it’s gonna work.
